The Recycle Bin allows users to recover files that have been deleted in Windows. questions.question: Which of the following is not an Operating System?
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is  Microsoft Office An operating system is the most important software that runs on a computer. It manages the computer's memory and processes , as well as all of its software and hardware . It also allows you to communicate with the computer without knowing how to speak the computer's language. Without an operating system, a computer is useless . questions.question: HTML stands for _________.
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is   HyperText Markup Language . First developed by Tim Berners-Lee in 1990, HTML is short for Hypertext Markup Language. HTML is used to create electronic documents (called pages) that are displayed on the World Wide Web. It is a language used for writing source codes for developing a webpage, inserting content, and other components in it. CPU is the control centre of the computer and hence it is said to be the brain of the computer. questions.question: A computer stores data in the ________ format.
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is  Binary Computers have switches to represent data and switches have only two states: ON and OFF. Binary has two digits to do the counting: 0 and 1 (0 = OFF, 1 = ON). सही उत्तर है   बाइनरी कंप्यूटर में डेटा का प्रतिनिधित्व करने के लिए स्विच हैं और स्विचेस के पास केवल दो स्थितियां हैं: चालू और बंद। गिनती करने के लिए द्विआधारी के दो अंक हैं: 0 और 1 (0 = बंद, 1 = चालू)।

A magnetic disk is a circular plate constructed of metal or plastic coated with magnetized material. questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is  Scanner. A scanner is a device that converts printed documents into Digital Images.
